universities.name: Hubei University of Education
universities.overview: Hubei University of Education is a provincial undergraduate institution in Wuhan, Hubei. Its 2026 international admission brochure lists English-taught degrees in International Economics and Trade and Electronic Information Science and Technology, a Chinese-taught degree in Teaching Chinese to Speakers of Other Languages, and a one-year Chinese language route.

programs.name: International Economics and Trade
qualifications: Non-Chinese citizen with a valid foreign passport and in good health.
High-school graduation or equivalent with good academic performance; the official graduation certificate must be available before enrolment.
For the 2026 cycle: age 18 or above, born before 1 September 2008. Applicants under 18 must supply a power of attorney from their guardian.
Nationality eligibility is subject to the relevant Chinese Ministry of Education regulations.
languageRequirements: For applicants from countries where English is neither the native nor an official language: IELTS 5.5+, TOEFL 75+ or Duolingo 95+.
Applicants without a standardised English certificate must take and pass the university language test.
documents: Hubei University of Education international student application form.
Registration photograph.
Passport.
Highest education certificate and academic transcript. Documents outside Chinese or English require notarised translations.
Financial guarantee letter from a sponsor with a bank deposit certificate or other proof of funds for tuition and living costs.
Health certificate.
Non-criminal record certificate.
A self-introduction video lasting 1-3 minutes.
English proficiency certificate where relevant to the teaching language.
Optional: recommendation letters, award certificates and academic performance certificates.

notes: 2026 admission information. Current intake availability must be confirmed separately.
Selection uses document review, interviews and other university assessments.
The university checks original qualifications and identity during registration; failure of the qualification review can revoke admission.
Applicants with CSCA scores receive priority under otherwise equal admission conditions.
scholarships: The 2026 Liberal Arts freshman scholarship is CNY 10,000 for admitted students. It is shown separately from the published tuition and must not be treated as an unconditional upfront fee reduction.
Scholarships in years 2-4 require university assessment: CNY 10,000 for the top 10%, CNY 5,000 for the top 15%, and CNY 3,000 for the top 20% of enrolled international students.

universities.name: Wenzhou University
universities.overview: Wenzhou University is a comprehensive university in Wenzhou, Zhejiang. The 2026 undergraduate brochure lists international study options in business, languages, education, science and engineering, with programme-specific CSCA examination subjects and annual tuition of CNY 18,000, CNY 20,000 or CNY 22,000. The 2026 application window has closed.

programs.name: International Economics and Trade
qualifications: Non-Chinese citizen holding a valid passport and in good health.
Age 18 or above; applicants under 18 must provide a certificate of guardianship.
High-school graduation certificate.
All international applicants for undergraduate programmes must provide valid CSCA results. The required examination subjects depend on the programme.
Required CSCA subjects: Mathematics.
languageRequirements: Non-native English speakers: TOEFL greater than 70, IELTS greater than 6, Duolingo greater than 105, or other evidence of English proficiency. The brochure uses strict greater-than signs.
documents: Photocopy of passport.
Highest graduation certificate and official transcript in Chinese or English; other languages need notarised Chinese or English translations.
Health report issued within six months, using the university medical examination form.
Non-criminal record certificate issued within six months.
Bank statement issued within six months. A signed sponsorship letter is required when the account belongs to another person.
Valid China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA) transcript.
For applicants already in China, a copy of the residence permit and a performance statement from the previous school, where applicable.
Optional: study plan and recommendation letter.

fees.notes: Accommodation charges are not specified in this brochure.
Approximate amount in the brochure.
Approximate amount in the brochure.
Brochure amounts: CNY 400 for less than one year or CNY 800 for one year. Confirm the applicable duration before budgeting.

notes: 2026 application window: 3 March to 30 June 2026. This application window is closed.
The brochure does not specify the programme duration or an arrival date.
scholarships: Wenzhou University Freshman Scholarship: Type A CNY 18,000; Type B CNY 10,000; Type C CNY 6,000. Awards are paid after successful registration and are not an automatic upfront tuition discount.

Zhejiang Provincial Scholarship and Wenzhou University International Student Academic Scholarship are listed for non-freshmen; amounts and eligibility follow the relevant policies and university notices.
